description: This file defines a configuration class for IBM WatsonX's chat model transformations and utility methods to map parameters, generate URLs, prepare request payloads, and apply prompt templates for IBM WatsonX models in a chat interface. It specifically handles compatibility with OpenAI-style parameters and WatsonX-specific patterns, integrating prompt template logic for various models.

classes.name: IBMWatsonXChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for transforming and interfacing with IBM WatsonX chat models, providing parameter mapping, URL construction, payload preparation, and prompt template application methods.

methods.name: List get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI-compatible parameters supported by this WatsonX chat config.

methods.name: bool is_tool_choice_option(self, tool_choice: Optional[Union[str, dict]])
methods.description: Determines if a given tool choice parameter value is an option for tool selection.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI-style parameters to WatsonX-specific parameters, handling tools and options, delegating to superclass for additional mapping.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Fetches API base URL and API key, sourcing from secrets if necessary.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for WatsonX chat, considering deployment IDs and stream options.

methods.name: dict _prepare_payload(self, model: str, api_params: WatsonXAPIParams)
methods.description: Prepares the request payload, adjusting model identifiers for deployment or standard models.

methods.name: Optional[str] _apply_prompt_template_core( model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, str]], hf_template_fn )
methods.description: Core logic for selecting and applying prompt templates based on model pattern; supports multiple styles including Granite, Mistral, GPT, and LLaMA.

methods.name: Optional[str] aapply_prompt_template( model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, str]] )
methods.description: Asynchronous version of applying prompt templates, supporting async template functions with exception handling.

methods.name: Optional[str] apply_prompt_template( model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, str]] )
methods.description: Synchronous method to apply prompt templates to messages using the core function.
